children: set new long-term targets ahead of its Wednesday investor day, aiming for an operating margin in the low-to-mid 50% range by 2030, up from 46.1% in 2025. Shares opened at $250.29.

The company also committed as much as $8.5 billion through 2036 to help franchisees fund restaurant upgrades. About $5 billion of that franchisee support lands by 2030 through rent relief and direct capital. That comes alongside $1.5 billion to $2 billion in extra capital spending from 2027 to 2030, on top of roughly $3 billion a year in routine capex.

The upgrades cover new equipment, technology and an AI-powered restaurant operating system called ArchIQ. McDonald's projects the efficiency gains will add about $100,000 in annual cash flow at the average U.S. restaurant, paying back the investment in around four years.

General and administrative spending is expected to fall to about 1.9% of systemwide sales by 2030, from a forecast 2.2% this year. It's also targeting roughly 1.5 percentage points of added global market share in both chicken and beverages by 2030.

title: McDonald's Commits $8.5 Billion to Franchisees, Targets Higher Margins
